events.name: [character], Last of His Line
events.text: [character] is gone, but [rival] has little time to mourn his passing. His death throws the noble houses of [rival] into a mad scramble for control. A mad scramble for which you, [character], have positioned yourself well. With the sway of [family] backing your swift coronation, only a small faction of [family] remain holdouts for their own claim to the throne.
